Okay, before anything is said, here's a disclaimer: I don't have this plant! These are actually "cheater" photos because Rob Co of the Pitcher Plant Project had me hold onto this plant temporarily for him. While in my care, I snapped a couple of photos, hehe



This plant can turn almost dark black under optimal conditions, and it was still early in the season, so the colors hadn't fully set in yet. So wish I had one of these, GOSH!




A pitcher that just opened:



And a trap on the same exact plant that's older and coloring up:



You can tell I'm a professional photographer, check out that hose in the background used as artistic "decoration" to enhance the colors, or something like that :



That's all! Won't be able to update this thread until the eventual day that I'm lucky enough to get one of these, if ever....

posts.body_html:
Got the absolute most PINNER (Northern California slang for "small") divison of black widow last year and it almost died half way through the grow season, but somehow it survived and produced this absolutely stunning pitcher! I suppose for now it's currently a super brilliant bright red widow for me, it'll prolly color up better later on in the season....but I don't really care, this bright color might be even better than when it gets darker. Thanks again Phil for making this crazy amazing clone.
